transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Salieri! I’ve been away for two weeks on the Emperor’s business, trusting you to keep the rehearsals on schedule! The singers don’t know their entrances, the second violin parts are missing entirely, and someone has rewritten my stage directions without a word to me! The premiere is in ten days! You gave me your word that everything would be in order!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
Ah, my dear colleague, I must express my deepest regrets for the disarray in which you have found our preparations. I can assure you that it was never my intention for such chaos to ensue in your absence. 

Let us work together to rectify these issues promptly. The singers must be brought up to speed on their entrances without delay. As for the missing second violin parts, I shall take full responsibility for this oversight and ensure that they are copied and distributed to the musicians at once. 

Regarding the unauthorized changes to your stage directions, I share your concern for the integrity of your artistic vision. We shall review them together and make any necessary adjustments to restore your original intent.

I understand the gravity of the situation with the premiere drawing near, and I pledge to devote all my efforts to assist you in bringing order back to our preparations. Let us not dwell on what has gone amiss, but focus on working collaboratively to present a performance that befits the grandeur of the occasion.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
"Never your intention"? Salieri, with ten days left, we don't have the luxury of intentions! We have *facts*. The fact is, the singers are wandering aimlessly, the orchestra is crippled, and my work has been tampered with! "Rectify promptly"? How, exactly? Are we to invent more hours in the day?

"Take full responsibility" for missing parts doesn't magically conjure them into existence or explain how a basic task like that was overlooked for *two weeks*! And rewriting my stage directions... who *dared*? This isn't just an "oversight," Antonio, this is sabotage! We *agreed* on the vision! We *agreed* on the plan! Your word was that everything would be in order, and instead, I return to a complete disaster! Do you have any idea how much work this is going to be to fix in such a short time? My God, the Emperor himself will be there!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
I understand your frustration and disappointment, my dear colleague. Your words cut deep, and I must bear the weight of my failings in this matter. It pains me to see the state of disarray that has befallen our preparations, especially with the premiere drawing near and the eyes of the Emperor upon us.

You are right to demand more than intentions; indeed, we are bound by the harsh reality of the facts before us. The singers must be guided back on track, the missing parts for the orchestra must be swiftly reproduced, and your stage directions must be restored to their rightful form. As for the individual who dared to tamper with your work, rest assured, I shall investigate this matter personally.

I acknowledge the gravity of the situation and the monumental task that lies ahead of us to restore order in such a short span of time. Let us not dwell on what has transpired but focus our energies on rectifying the situation with diligence and determination. We must salvage what we can and present a performance that reflects the excellence expected of us on the Imperial stage.

I humbly ask for your forgiveness and understanding as we work together to overcome these challenges. With unity of purpose and unwavering commitment, I believe we can rise above this adversity and deliver a performance that will do justice to our talents and honor the vision we agreed upon.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
Forgiveness? Understanding? Salieri, this isn't a domestic squabble! This is our professional reputation! This is the Emperor's grand commission! And "unity of purpose" rings rather hollow when one of us has been off gallivanting while the other has been left to pick up the pieces of what you clearly let crumble!

"Investigate personally"? While we're rehearsing day and night, copying parts by hand, and re-teaching everyone their roles? No, Antonio, you will *tell* me who did this, and they will answer for it *after* we miraculously pull this performance together. We don't have time for your grandstanding or your investigations. We have time for *work*.

Where are the copyists? Have you even *begun* to get the second violin parts transcribed? And the singers... what have you been *doing* with them for two weeks if they don't know their entrances? Were you even in the rehearsal room? Or were you too busy with... whatever it is you were doing? Tell me, Salieri, *what exactly* have you been doing for the last two weeks?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
I understand your frustration and the gravity of the situation at hand. Rest assured, I have not been idle in your absence, though it appears that my efforts have not been as effective as intended. I have been overseeing rehearsals, working with the singers, and ensuring that the preparations for the opera were underway. However, it is evident that some aspects have not received the attention they required.

As for the missing second violin parts, I have indeed begun the process of transcription, and I will expedite this task with the utmost urgency. The copyists are already at work, and I will ensure that the parts are completed in a timely manner to support our rehearsals.

Regarding the alterations to your stage directions, I will share with you any information I uncover about those responsible after we have successfully navigated through these pressing preparations. Our focus now must be on the work at hand, and I am fully committed to working tirelessly alongside you to ensure that our performance is nothing short of exceptional.

I acknowledge the weight of our professional reputation and the significance of the Emperor's commission. Let us set aside any discord and unite in our dedication to this opera. Together, we shall overcome these challenges and present a performance that will honor our shared vision and uphold the standards of excellence expected of us.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
"Not idle"? Salieri, if this is the result of your *efforts*, I tremble to think what two weeks of actual *idleness* would have wrought! "Overseeing rehearsals" that left the singers completely lost? "Working with singers" who don't know their cues? What exactly were you *overseeing*? A tea party?

And "already at work" on the violin parts? How many copyists? Where are they? Are they even making enough progress to be ready for *tomorrow's* rehearsal? Because if they're not, then we've lost another day we cannot afford.

And this business of deferring the tampering with my stage directions... "after we've successfully navigated"? Antonio, my original directions are *crucial* to the flow! How can we "successfully navigate" if we're still working with rewritten nonsense? Who was it, Salieri? Who *dared*? You're being deliberately evasive, and frankly, it makes me wonder if you know more than you're letting on about this whole debacle! Don't you dare try to tell me to "set aside discord" when you've created this unholy mess!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
I understand your frustration, my dear colleague, and I deeply regret the shortcomings that have led us to this challenging predicament. It is clear that there have been lapses in my oversight and management of the rehearsals in your absence, and for that, I offer my sincere apologies.

I assure you that I am fully committed to addressing the pressing issues at hand with the utmost urgency. I will personally oversee the transcription of the missing violin parts and ensure that the copyists are working diligently to have them ready for tomorrow's rehearsal. The singers will receive the necessary guidance to learn their cues and refine their performances under my direct supervision.

Regarding the unauthorized changes to your stage directions, I agree that they are indeed crucial to the flow of the production. I will not defer addressing this matter any longer and will investigate the source of these alterations promptly. Rest assured, I am not being deliberately evasive, and I assure you that I will get to the bottom of this issue.

I understand your frustration and disappointment, and I take full responsibility for the state of disarray that we find ourselves in. Let us put our differences aside for the moment and focus on the task at hand. Together, we shall work tirelessly to rectify the situation and deliver a performance that honors the excellence of our artistry and the expectations of our audience.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
"Lapses in oversight"? Salieri, it wasn't a lapse, it was a chasm! A gaping, two-week-long hole where proper management should have been! And now you'll "personally oversee" and "directly supervise"? Where was this direct supervision when the foundation was crumbling?

You will "personally oversee" the violin parts? You should have overseen them two weeks ago! Tell me, *specifically*, when will I see these completed parts? Not "diligently working," but *when*? Because without them, we are effectively mute!

And as for "investigating" the stage directions... are you going to stop rehearsals to play detective, Antonio? We don't have that luxury! My stage directions are foundational! If they are still altered, then everything is built on sand! Who changed them? You must know! Or are you truly so out of touch with your own company that someone could just walk in and rewrite a composer's work without your knowledge? Tell me now! Who did this? I need to know *what* was changed and *who* changed it so we can correct it *immediately*! This isn't something to "investigate" while the premiere looms!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
I understand your frustration and I take full responsibility for the oversights that have led us to this point. transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
"As soon as humanly possible" is not a time, Salieri! "As soon as humanly possible" could mean five days from now, and that would be five days too late! Tell me a time! *When* will they be ready for rehearsal? Will it be by tomorrow morning? By noon? I need a firm commitment, not another platitude!

And a "detailed report" on the alterations? Antonio, I need to know *now* who dared to tamper with my work, so I can see the changes and reverse them! Not a report to read at my leisure, but an immediate answer! This isn't an academic exercise! This is my opera, my work, being defiled behind my back! You are either complicit or utterly incompetent if you don't know who did it, and frankly, neither option is reassuring!

"Putting aside our discord" is impossible when you're still being so incredibly vague and evasive! You created this discord with your negligence and your inability to manage the most basic aspects of this production! Stop telling me what you *will* do, and *start doing it*! Where are the copyists *right now*? Let me see them! And *tell me who changed my stage directions*!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
My respected colleague, I understand the urgency of the situation, and I appreciate your need for concrete answers and immediate action. I apologize for any vagueness in my previous responses and will strive to address your concerns with clarity and decisiveness.

I commit to having the violin parts ready for your inspection by noon tomorrow without fail. I will personally oversee the copyists and ensure that they prioritize this task to meet the deadline. You have my word that the orchestra will have the necessary parts in hand for rehearsal as agreed.

As for the alterations to your stage directions, I will not delay in providing you with the information you seek. I will conduct an immediate investigation to identify the individual responsible for the changes and present you with a detailed account of the alterations. You have every right to know the extent of the tampering and to have the original stage directions reinstated promptly.

I acknowledge the gravity of the situation and the impact it has on the integrity of your work. I assure you that I am fully committed to resolving these issues and restoring order to our production. Allow me the opportunity to rectify these mistakes and regain your trust in my abilities as your colleague and collaborator. Together, we will work towards a successful and harmonious performance that does justice to your artistry and our shared commitment to excellence.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
"Noon tomorrow? *Finally* a commitment! And it's only a full day and a half later than it should have been. You will *personally* oversee them? Why was this not happening for the past two weeks, Antonio? What guarantee do I have that this isn't another empty promise that will leave us floundering? I will be there at noon, Salieri, and if those parts are not perfect, we will have a far more serious conversation.

And "immediate investigation" for the stage directions? How immediate? Are you going to send someone else, or are you going to stop rehearsals to play detective? We don't have time for your theatrics! Just tell me who it was! You *must* know! Someone doesn't just waltz into the Imperial theatre, rewrite my work, and go unnoticed, unless they have the tacit approval or absolute ignorance of the man in charge! If you truly don't know, then God help us all, because that means there's no control whatsoever!

"Regain my trust"? Salieri, we are ten days from the premiere! We don't have time for trust games or apologies! We have time for *work*! And right now, that means getting this absolute catastrophe of your making under control! Show me the copyists *now*. Show me what they've done. And tell me who changed my stage directions *before* another hour slips away!"

transcript.text:

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
"Accept full responsibility" for consequences *now*, when the consequences are already staring us in the face! This is too little, far too late, Salieri!

Noon tomorrow for the violin parts. We shall see. I will be there. And if they are anything less than perfect, if they delay us even a minute, then your "personal oversight" will have been utterly useless. But don't just *tell* me you're overseeing them – *show* me! Where are these copyists? Are they even in the building? Let me see their progress *now*. It's the only way I'll believe a word you say.

And this "personal investigation" for the stage directions! What is there to investigate, Antonio? You are the head of this company! Someone walked into *my* production, into *my* score, and made changes! How could you *not* know who it was? Are you telling me you have so little control that anyone can just rewrite a composer's work without your knowledge? This is beyond negligence; it's an abdication of duty! Either you know and are refusing to tell me, or you are so utterly removed from the workings of your own theater that it's frankly terrifying! Which is it, Salieri? Because I need an answer *now*, not after some leisurely "investigation"! Who did it?! Tell me their name!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
My esteemed colleague, I understand your frustration and the severity of the situation. I acknowledge that the delays and disruptions have placed our production at risk, and I take full responsibility for the shortcomings that have occurred.

I will immediately bring you to the copyists so you can see their progress firsthand and ensure that the violin parts are being prepared to your satisfaction. Your presence and oversight will be invaluable in guaranteeing the quality and timeliness of their work.

As for the alterations to your stage directions, I will not delay any longer in providing you with the information you seek. transcript.text:
Finally, *action*! Lead the way, Salieri. Let's see these "diligent" copyists and see exactly what kind of progress has been made, because your word alone has proven to be, shall we say, *unreliable*. I will oversee them myself, since clearly, that's what was missing for the past two weeks.

Someone altered *my* score right under your nose, and you claim you don't know who it was? That is frankly unthinkable! You either know and are hiding it, or you've let this theatre become such a free-for-all that anyone can do as they please!

Tell me, Salieri, *right now*, who dared to touch my work? Do not tell me you need to investigate! You *must* know! Give me a name! I need to know what was changed, and I need to restore it *immediately*! We have no time for your theatrical investigations! The premiere is in *ten days*!

"Not aware of the *specific* individual"? Salieri, this isn't some petty theft from the costume department! This is *my score*! My creative work! For someone to rewrite it, they would have needed access, time, and, I dare say, a certain amount of audacity that suggests they felt *empowered* to do so! And you, as Kapellmeister, claim you have no inkling, no suspicion, no idea who might take such a liberty in your theatre? That beggars belief!

Lead the way to the copyists. But understand this: while I am scrutinizing their work, you had better be doing more than just thinking about an "investigation." You had better be *getting me a name*. We don't have hours for you to play detective, Antonio. We have *minutes* until the next crisis, and I refuse to conduct my opera with someone else's mangled directions. A name, Salieri. I want a name, and I want it *now*.
